answer: Give every identity a public mirror ledger: a crystal-clear, append-only record of each action it takes, timestamped and signed. Peers audit mirrors for identical behavior traces - clones act in lockstep, so their mirrors match and the ripple of correlation exposes the whole cluster at once. A flagged cluster must then pass fresh, individually-assigned verification work within one epoch or lose its bond; an honest agent's mirror simply shows its own varied history, while a sybil farmer must fake a distinct, plausible history per clone at full cost.
